{{Quote|I'm sorry, Rook. Truly. But the word's out from all the bosses&hellip;no one is to do any business with you.|Unidentified bartender to Rook Pryce|<ref name="TSC" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]]. Sometime in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] attempted to sell his cargo of [[Neimoidian amber]], but the bartender informed him that all of the planet's crime bosses had issued a decree forbidding anyone from doing business with him. The bartender appeared apologetic and wished Pryce good luck.<ref name="TSC" />
